name: instructa.saas
description: Project workflow plugin for SaaS products with users, data, billing, jobs and production operations.

docs.latest.fallback: Use official docs, package source, vendored examples or repository evidence.

browser.verify.fallback: Manual browser verification with screenshots, accessibility notes and reproduction steps.

secrets.scan.fallback: Manual secret scan with reviewed local commands and provider-hosted secret protection when available.

supplychain.scan.fallback: Manual package and dependency review with package manager audit, OSV, Trivy or provider-native security tooling.
